tips.title: Set up exchange folders and user rights
tips.body: Create a Windows folder for tool data exchange and set full access rights for the synchronization service.

tips.title: Configure user rights in local security policy
tips.body: For Account option, configure the relevant user rights for the service account in Local Security Policy.

tips.title: Start the Synchronization Service
tips.body: Run omTdbServiceUi.exe as administrator and configure input format, database, and data exchange folder.

tips.title: Preserve folder structure during import
tips.body: Check the 'P' (Preserve) column to keep the original folder structure during data import.

tips.title: Set 'Slave' database for write protection
tips.body: Check the 'S' (Slave) column to make the database read-only, allowing only the synchronization service to modify it.

tips.title: Select account with necessary access rights
tips.body: Choose an account that has the required permissions to access the exchange directory and database.

tips.title: Synchronize multiple instances
tips.body: Add multiple exchange folders and hyperMILL databases to synchronize them into a single tool database.

tips.title: Check synchronization logs
tips.body: Click the 'Log...' button to view and analyze log files for any issues during synchronization.

tips.title: Start and stop synchronization service
tips.body: Click 'Start' to activate all instances, and 'Stop' to deactivate them.
